title: FastImage pod needs a different subspec
issue: pod install fails: the RNFastImage podspec requires a platform not configured.
log:
Analyzing dependencies
[!] CocoaPods could not find compatible versions for pod "RNFastImage":
  In Podfile:
    RNFastImage (from `../node_modules/react-native-fast-image`)

[!] The Swift pod `RNFastImage` could not be found in project ios/Podfile

broken.ios/Podfile:
require_relative '../node_modules/react-native/scripts/react_native_pods'
require_relative '../node_modules/@react-native-community/cli-platform-ios/native_modules'

platform :ios, '13.4'

target 'rn-bench-app' do
  config = use_native_modules!
  use_react_native!(
    :path => config[:reactNativePath],
    :hermes_enabled => true
  )
end

healthy.ios/Podfile:
require_relative '../node_modules/react-native/scripts/react_native_pods'
require_relative '../node_modules/@react-native-community/cli-platform-ios/native_modules'

platform :ios, '13.4'

target 'rn-bench-app' do
  config = use_native_modules!
  use_react_native!(
    :path => config[:reactNativePath],
    :hermes_enabled => true
  )
  pod 'RNFastImage', :path => '../node_modules/react-native-fast-image'
end
